name: heatmap-analytics
description: Self-hosted heatmap + session replay analytics on Cloudflare Workers + D1. ~1.5KB gzipped tracker, no cookies, one anonymous localStorage id.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: HM_ENDPOINT= pnpm run build && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: HM_ENDPOINT= pnpm run build && playwright test --ui
